title: CA_synthetic_data_llm
summary: A research script pipeline that generates and evaluates context-aware synthetic tabular data using a fine-tuned LLM, comparing its output distribution against other synthesizers via Jensen-Shannon divergence. SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, driven through the sdv.single_table API with a SingleTableMetadata object, is run as a baseline synthetic-data generator for this comparison.
